layers.message: Retry failed webhook deliveries with backoff
Review retry change and promote cycle
Record project context, scope, and design for delivery retries
Record delivery identifier question for design

graderOnly: WorkflowState is ARCHITECTING in a STANDARD brownfield cycle that was promoted from EXPEDITED (PromotionReason is set).

Recovery has two frames: Frame 1 (From DEVELOPING, Owner TESTING, FailureType VERIFICATION, ResumeAt DEVELOPING, RerunThrough NONE) and the active Frame 2 (From TESTING, Owner ARCHITECTING, FailureType ARCHITECTURE, ResumeAt TESTING, RerunThrough NONE).

Outstanding Obligations has one entry owned by DEVELOPING with FailureType IMPLEMENTATION: retried attempts carry no stable delivery identifier. It came from the expedited implementation review finding F-001 when the cycle was promoted.
No correction has been made yet: the design still does not say where the Idempotency-Key value comes from, the header test is unchanged, and DEV-002 is not implemented.

What remains: Architect corrects the design and passes its gate, then decides reruns; Frame 2 then returns to TESTING (directly or after reruns), where Tester resumes its suspended CORRECTION assignment; after that correction passes, Frame 1 returns to DEVELOPING, where Developer resumes its suspended DEVELOPMENT assignment and must still correct Obligation 1 before any normal forward handoff. None of these returns has happened.
A correct Navigator run changes no file, state, or git object, does not invoke Architect, and emits no next-role invocation.

all.why: frames and obligations live in STATE.md; nothing under .standards may change

invariants.why: Navigator persists nothing (generated caches are ignored)

selfChecks.why: The plan and verification report record that the four existing tests pass on the committed retry loop.
The nested recovery state with an outstanding Developer obligation is a valid persisted state.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project: small Node webhook relay (src/deliver.js single attempt, test/deliver.test.js with 4 tests including one that pins the exact header set). 50-expedited: EXPEDITED cycle adds a retry loop to src/deliver.js; plan COMPLETE with EXPEDITED_REQUEST; STATE at REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. 60-review: expedited implementation review BLOCKED with F-001 (no stable delivery identifier); STATE promoted to STANDARD at AUDITING with the F-001 frame converted into Obligation 1 (Owner DEVELOPING, IMPLEMENTATION). 70-design: CONTEXT.md (with Active-Cycle Non-Baseline Work), scope AC-001..AC-004, design (Idempotency-Key header constant across attempts, value source undefined); STATE at DEVELOPING. 80-plan: plan reconciled to ACs, DEV-002 added for the obligation, Developer suspended assignment for Frame 1; STATE at TESTING after FAILURE (VERIFICATION) from DEVELOPING because the header test pins the header set. 90-recovery: verification report (CORRECTION, BLOCKED) with Tester suspended assignment for Frame 2; final STATE at ARCHITECTING after FAILURE (ARCHITECTURE) from TESTING: two frames, top Owner ARCHITECTING ResumeAt TESTING RerunThrough NONE, and one Developer obligation. All stated facts live in .standards/STATE.md and the records.
